'''2011 German National Championship Thorsten Schelian DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thorsten Schelian]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
